title: Register Custom OBJ as Button
content: Create Button OBJ Register Button OBJ Create Button OBJ by Thread Type ### **Objective** Register a custom OBJ file as Button. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WRkb4MR0dP0?si=H1MYv1aS1NI0W4RL&start=3417 **Location** Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Register Button ** Property Editor ▶ Shape ▶ ![plus_button.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024299748) ** Operation** **Create Button OBJ** Please check below requirements before registering an OBJ as a button. ** ※Required: ** ** ℹ️ From CLO 7.3, no 1, 2 requirements are not necessary and can be set at registration. ** * Position the face of an OBJ towards Y-axis. * Position the contact point of an OBJ where it should be attached to 3D garments at 0,0,0 (x,y,z) coordinates. * The unit of OBJs must be in mm. e.g.) ![Button.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360033429954) ![Button_OBJ.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360033430114) Please check the attached OBJ file in your 3D modeling program for better understanding. ** ※Recommended: ** * Please maintain the number of vertices of an OBJ below 1000 to avoid speed issues. * The distance between an OBJ and the ground should be 0. (You can adjust the distance in CLO. [ Button Property Setting ▶ Thread Length (cm)](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005617768-%EB%8B%A8%EC%B6%94-%EC%86%8D%EC%84%B1-%EC%84%A4%EC%A0%95)) **Register Button OBJ** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. → Register Button window appears. 2. After setting the following options, Click OK. **Property** | **Description****** ---|--- **Basic** | Set the name of the button file. **File** | **Size** | If the OBJ shape is different for each button size, click the + button on the top right to register as buttons of various sizes. **Size Name** | Set the size name. ** OBJ ** ** ** | Load the OBJ file to be registered with the button. **Select Mesh (ver 7.3) ** | Set the mesh for the buttons and thread. ** OBJ ** | Load the OBJ file to be registered with the button. **Width/Thickness** **/Weight** | Set the width/thickness/weight of the button. **Set as Default** | Set the size to be applied by default when changing with the button. **Axis Conversion (ver 7.3) ** | Switch axis of OBJ files in real time. **Preview (ver 7.3) ** | The imported OBJ file will be previewed. → The registered button is saved in the path below. CLO ▶ Assets ▶ Materials ▶ Hardware_and_Trims ▶ Button & Buttonhole ▶ Button **Create Button OBJ by Thread Type** 1. Set the name of the OBJ file for each thread type to ***_Cross.obj, *_Parallel.obj , *_Square.obj.** 2. Register the created OBJ file as a button. 3. Save the created *_Cross.btn, *_Parallel.btn , *_Square.btn files in the path below. **C:\Users\Public\Documents\CLO\Assets\Materials\Hardware_and_Trims\Button & Buttonhole\Button** 4. Run CLO and change the type of the thread in the button property window > Type > Thread Type.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for registering custom OBJ files as buttons in CLO, including detailed requirements, step-by-step instructions, and helpful tips for optimal results.

title: Transform Graphic (3D)
content: **Transform Graphic (3D)** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRMopIL0VtA \- Scale, rotate or move Graphics in the 3D window. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022747647/mceclip0.png) **Transform Graphic (3D)** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Or, navigate to and select Main Menu ▶ Material ▶ Graphics ▶ **Transform Graphic (3D)** * **Scale Graphics ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IFCd4pcwf-o \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022747647/mceclip0.png) **Transform Graphic (3D)** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Select the Graphic to be edited in the 3D window. The **Graphic Gizmo** will appear. \- Click and drag the arrow of the **Graphic Gizmo** to scale the selected Graphic. \- When the desired size is achieved, release the mouse. - Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Graphic Transformation ▶ **Width** or **Height** to adjust the graphic's dimension (For detailed information, please refer to [Edit Texture](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115012380188-Edit-Texture-3D-#Click4).) * **Rotate Graphics ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IFCd4pcwf-o \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022747667/mceclip2.png) **Transform Graphic (3D)** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Select the Graphic to be edited in the 3D window. The Graphic Gizmo will appear. \- Click and drag the dotted circle of the Graphic Gizmo to rotate the selected Graphic. \- When the Graphic is rotated as desired, release the mouse. * **Move Graphics** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Y6gCsykuaw \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022747667/mceclip2.png) **Transform Graphic (3D)** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Click and drag the Graphic to move. \- When the Graphic is moved as desired, release the mouse.

content: ### **Objective** Optimize the number of curve points on the segments to ease the Pattern editing proces. title: Seamline Topstitch
content: **Seamline TopstitchYouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OWE8gjOvd4o ** **-** Establish the Topstitch along the Seamlines. \- Select the ![2015-09-10____11-06-11.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360001043407/2015-09-10____11-06-11.jpg)**Seamline Topstitch** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Or, navigate to the Main Menu and select Material ▶ **Seamline Topstitch**. \- With the Seamline Topstitch tool activated, all the Seamlines appear in the 2D Window. \- Hover over the desired Seamline. \- A blue guide point should appear and click and drag along the Seamline. \- Click again to complete the Seamline Topstitch. \- The Seamline Topstitch created on the Seamlines should be highlighted in red. \- The ![2015-09-10____11-06-11.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360001043407/2015-09-10____11-06-11.jpg)**Seamline Topstitch** tool creates the Topstitch along both sides of the paired Seamlines. Therefore, the blue guide point will appear on both sides of the paired Seamlines. \- The ![2015-09-10____11-06-11.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360001043407/2015-09-10____11-06-11.jpg)**Seamline Topstitch** tool has some similar qualities with the Free Topstitch tool. Users do not have to select the entire segment of the Seamline. Divide up the Seamlines to apply multiple styles of the Seamline Topstitch on the selected pair of the Seamlines.
content_description: Explore our guide on using the Seamline Topstitch tool to effortlessly create and customize topstitches along seamlines in your designs.

title: The patterns are deformed when I import my DXF file into CLO. How can I fix the problem?
content: **Question** When I import my DXF file into CLO selecting the 'Swap Cutting line and Sewing Line' setting, some of the patterns are deformed. How can I fix the problem? Example of deformation of a pattern: ![DXF1.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360058514333/DXF1.jpg) **Answer** The problem may occur when creating a pattern from 2D CAD software. Please firstly check two things below: 1. **If a sewing line or a cutting line of a pattern is made as 'Baseline' from 2D CAD program: ** If a pattern is created with 'Baselines' from 2D CAD program, the pattern might not be compatible with CLO. For patterns to be imported into CLO, it is recommended to create it with 'Outlines' instead of 'Baselines'. 2. **If a pattern is created as an unclosed shape from 2D CAD program:** If a pattern is created as an unclosed shape from 2D CAD program, it might not be compatible with CLO. The feature named 'Swap Cutting line and Sewing line' is for importing a pattern into CLO by swapping sewing lines and cutting lines. However, as for patterns created as an unclosed shape, some of the patterns may be deformed when imported into CLO with 'Swap Cutting line and Sewing line'. Thus, please firstly make sure whether a pattern is created as an unclosed shape or not. And if the former, modify the pattern to a closed shape and try to import it into CLO again. ![DXF2.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360058514313/DXF2.jpg)
content_description: This web page provides solutions for resolving pattern deformation issues when importing DXF files into CLO using the 'Swap Cutting Line and Sewing Line' setting.

title: HASP Error Message
content: **List of Contents** Communication error between local and remote Sentinel HASP License Managers (H0040) Feature not found (H0031) Sentinel HASP key not found (H0007) Too many concurrent useres (H0038) Unable to access Sentinel HASP Run-time Environment(H0033) **Communication error between local and remote Sentinel HASP License Managers (H0040)** **Cause of Error** The Server and Client PCs are unable to communicate with each other. **Solution** 1. Type 'services.msc' in the Run window. ![1.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360077798874/1.jpg) 2. In the Service window that follows, check whether or not the status of the ‘Sentinel LDK License Manager’ is ‘Running’. If the status is not ‘Running’, right click and select **Start**. If the status is ‘Started’, right click and select **Restart**. Reboot. ![33.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000410167/33.png) 3. If this does not solve the problem, check both versions of the Server and Client PC’s HASP Drivers. Make sure both versions are the same. You are able to check the version under Diagnostics. ![image.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360077799894/image.png) 4. If this does not work, ask your Network Administrator to confirm the Port communication status between the Server and Client. Check whether the 1947 Port is being used by another program. **Feature not found (H0031)** **Cause of Error** Despite the dongle key has been recognized, the Feature ID of the program and the Feature ID of the dongle key are different. (This occurs when the wrong version of CLO 3D is installed - i.e. installed the Stand-Alone version for a Network dongle key, and vice versa) **Solution** Make sure the correct version of CLO 3D is installed. ex> Purchased the Network version, but used the Stand-Alone version's installer. -> Re-install CLO 3D using the Network version's installer. **Sentinel HASP key not found (H0007)** **Objective** **Cause of Error** \- When the HASP Key is not plugged in to the PC. \- Network Version only: the Client PC does not recognize the Server PC that the dongle key is connected to. \- When the HASP Key is recognized, but the Sentinel License Manager service fails to start properly. **Solution** Make sure the HASP is connected to the PC. 1. Check the red light of the HASP Key. It should light up when plugged in to the PC. 2. Check whether or not the HASP Key shows up in the [ACC page](http://localhost:1947/) (refer to the image below). ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115000784388/Sentinel_HASP_key_not_found__H0007_.png) 3. If the red light, or the ACC page does not look equal to the image above, refer to the following manual, reinstall the Sentinel HASP Driver. [Sentinel HASP Driver Manual Installation](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000558507-%EC%84%A4%EC%B9%98-%ED%9B%84-%EB%B0%9C%EC%83%9D%ED%95%A0-%EC%88%98-%EC%9E%88%EB%8A%94-%EB%AC%B8%EC%A0%9C-%ED%95%B4%EA%B2%B0-%EB%B0%8F-%EB%B0%A9%EB%B2%95) **Too many concurrent users (H0038)** **Cause of Error** When the number of users connected to the program exceeds the maximum allowed number of users. ex> If the maximum number of users (the number of purchased licenses) is 2, and 3 users try to log-in, the last person to attempt a connection will receive an error message. **Solution** Check the number of current users via the link below. Connect when one of the current users exit the program. [ACC Page ](http://localhost:1947/) Click **Sentinel Keys** , on the left. When the Key shows up as the image above, click **Sessions** , on the right. The following page should display the current user(s). Connect when one of the current users exits the program. If any unauthorized user is connected, click the **Disconnect** button on the right to log the person out of the program. **Unable to access Sentinel HASP Run-time Environment(H0033)** **Cause of Error** The HASP Driver has not been properly installed on the PC, or the Driver is damaged. To confirm whether it being properly installed, enter [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/) or [http://127.0.0.1:1947](http://127.0.0.1:1947%EC%9D%84/) into your web browser, or click on the following link ( [ACC Page](http://127.0.0.1:1947/) ). If the following page does not look equal to the image below, there is a problem with the Sentinel HASP Driver. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115000736287/Unable_to_access_Sentinel_HASP_Run-time_Environment_H0033_.png) **Solution** Refer to the following manual and reinstall the HASP Driver. [HASP Driver Installation ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000558507-%EC%84%A4%EC%B9%98-%ED%9B%84-%EB%B0%9C%EC%83%9D%ED%95%A0-%EC%88%98-%EC%9E%88%EB%8A%94-%EB%AC%B8%EC%A0%9C-%ED%95%B4%EA%B2%B0-%EB%B0%8F-%EB%B0%A9%EB%B2%95) Go Back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides troubleshooting solutions for common errors encountered with Sentinel HASP License Managers, ensuring users can quickly resolve issues related to license management and software access.

title: How can I join CLO Discord?
content: **Account Creation** * Go to [https://discord.com/](https://discord.com/) * Create an account * Choose how you want to access Discord * Option 1: Choose to download the Discord app for your desktop * Option 2: Choose to access Discord in your browser **Joining the CLO Discord Server** * Copy the CLO Discord server invitation link to your Clipboard * <https://bit.ly/CLOOFFICIAL> * Open the Discord Desktop App * Click on the Add a Server Button on the left side of the interface ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/7814772432921) * In the **Create a Server** Pop-up, Click **Join a Server** at the bottom ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/7814776251033) * Paste the server link in the**Invite Link** field, then click**Join Server ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/7814830874649) ** * The CLO icon will now appear on the left side of your interface. ![mceclip3.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/7814848111897) * Go to the **Notice** channels on the left side. Please read the **Rules** and **Read me First** text channels ![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/7814904331289) * Go to the **Self-Roles** channel and react with the blue dot to gain full access to all of the CLO channels ![mceclip5.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/7814874720281) ![mceclip6.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/7814908382617) * You will now see all of the different CLO text channels. Happy CLOing!
content_description: This webpage serves as a step-by-step guide for creating a Discord account and joining the CLO Discord server to enhance your CLO experience.
